name: insomnia
description: The open-source, cross-platform API client for GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC. With Cloud, Local and Git storage.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(INS-3850): revalidate a project's old organization cache when it moves parents by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10513
* fix(INS-3850): re-check Konnect organization visibility before restoring it on cold start by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10518
* fix: One line editor can enter new line issue by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10514
* fix(INS-3836): show the Konnect-moved notice only after a migration conflict is resolved by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10521
* fix: Both spec and collection should allow import test suites in git sync by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10524
* Fix: Do not flush on blur on one-line-editor if it is read-only  by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10534
* fix(sidebar): don't crash the collection filter on non-string doc fields by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10525
* fix(event-stream): only read event shaped lines from the event log by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10522
* chore(sandbox): disable quick.js sandbox temporarily by @ihexxa in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10536
* Fix: Add loading indicator and avoid unmount editor to update tag for tag editor by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10537
* fix(mcp): correct Add/Delete Item for nested object params by @CurryYangxx in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10546
* Chore: bump vault plugin version by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10547
* fix(environment-editor): treat empty JSON content as invalid JSON by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10540
* fix(INS-3507): restrict git-sync and legacy-folder writes to canSync model types by @kwburns-kong in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10531
* Change Konnect migration wording. by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10550
* feat(export): add Export OpenAPI Spec to the collection context menu by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10538
* fix(insomnia): run plugin yarn info in a controlled temp dir by @Tyagiquamar in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10505
* fix(script): use liquid sync method in render - INS-3789 by @ihexxa in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10523
* chore(ci): make the cycle check runnable on Windows and report drift honestly [INS-3904] by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10548
* refactor(sidebar): own the project shell in one layout route [INS-3903] by @yaoweiprc in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10541
* chore: bump app version to 13.3.0 by @insomnia-infra in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10552
* ci(ksai): add KSAI through the public mirror by @bartsmykla in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10551
* fix: constrain file template tag by @kwburns-kong in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10528
* fix: parse quoted CSV fields in collection runner data by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10557
* fix: de-flake import deep-link cURL auto-scan smoke test by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10555
* fix(toast): stop toast animations from swallowing clicks by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10553
* fix(key-value-editor): stop ListBox typeahead from swallowing typed spaces by @ZxBing0066 in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10563
* feat: Add base model schema and deep strict utility by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10515
* feat: Unify and migrate environment model to use Zod schema and infer type by @cwangsmv in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10516
* chore: bump @faker-js/faker@9.7.0 to 10.6.0 by @kwburns-kong in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10569
* ci(ksai): start a KSAI run only for people who can write to the repository by @bartsmykla in https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/pull/10578
* fix: Environment schema git export order issue by @cwangsmv in https
